title: Rocker from dawn to dusk
lead: Away from the lab, I'm a rock vocalist, songwriter and guitarist with more than a decade of live performance behind me — from the battle-of-the-bands circuit in Mangaluru to festival stages in the UK.
story: I started out fronting Avalanche Brakedown, a six-piece hard rock band from Mangaluru, as lead vocalist and primary songwriter. In its first year the band won ten battle-of-the-bands titles and represented the city at IIT Madras's Saarang, finishing sixth of forty acts nationally.

From 2016 to 2022 I was the lead vocalist and lyricist of Sounds Fishy, a hard rock and ambient metal band. Our debut original, "Sympathetic Race", made us the first band from Mangaluru to be played on British radio, our songs reached radio in the UK, New Zealand and the USA, and our debut EP, Retribution — loosely built around the seven deadly sins — was featured by Rolling Stone India.

Today my main project is The Speksy Pscyentist (TSP), a duo with fellow researcher Jyoshma D'Souza, where science meets symphony. Our 2024 single "Rain It Down on Me" was featured on VEVO, likely a first for a Mangalurean act.

projects.name: Sounds Fishy
projects.blurb: Mangaluru hard rock / ambient metal band. Runners-up for Best Rock Act of Mangaluru at their first contest, Hard Rock Rising winners (2017), and the only Asian act in the opening poll for the UK's Stonedead Festival 2020. Debut EP Retribution (2022).

projects.blurb: Six-piece hard rock band influenced by Scorpions, Megadeth, Pink Floyd and Dream Theater. Ten battle-of-the-bands wins in a year, sixth of forty at IIT Madras Saarang, and the single "Kill My Pain".
